row.evidence: Bombora's support FAQ says "Your internal Bombora Administrator is able to add seats" via Account Settings > Add User, with email and password login; no SCIM, SSO or user API appears on its site, support FAQ or developer portal.
row.notes: New row. Bombora (B2B intent data: Company Surge, Insights suite, audiences) publishes no pricing page; sales is via 'Speak to an expert'. Users are added manually by the customer's Bombora administrator and log in with email and password. The developer portal's six APIs (Authentication, Account List, Intent, Digital Audience, Reference, Webhooks) cover data, not users. No SCIM or SSO documentation found and no Okta OIN or Entra gallery app (both 404). The Zendesk help centre is closed, so the public support FAQ is the only help content. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).
